welcomeBody: Sign in with the phone number your school has.
phoneHint: 10 digits, the number your school has on record.
wrongPassword: That phone number and password don't match.
setupBody: First time here? Confirm your child's details and choose a password.
resetBody: Confirm your child's details and choose a new password.
admissionHint: It is on the admission slip or the fee receipt.
dobInvalid: Enter the date as DD / MM / YYYY.
detailsMismatch: Those details don't match our records. Check the phone number, admission number and date of birth.
tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
network: Couldn't reach the school's server. Check your connection and try again.
